'''Droo Wabbin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who worked for the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Drug dealer|dealer]] [[Bal Rado]]. Later he was hired by [[Sol Proofrock]] to eliminate his boss.
